desc:
⚡ The new version is here! Battles are so fast you can’t even see them — only the massive explosions remain! ⚡

Become the strongest Fighting Spirit! Win every battle you choose, grow stronger with each victory, and use your rewards to buy health, swords, and powerful skills.

👍 Like the game to support future updates!

“Prayer in Islam, along with healthy eating and daily exercise, brings deep and lasting happiness in this life. And when death comes, it leads to Paradise.
Abandoning prayer and following desires, however, brings profound misery in this world, and upon death leads to Hell — a wretched destiny.
Both paths have been tried in this life: happiness was found in the first, and sorrow in the second.”
